AllowedCollege.title: AllowedCollege
AllowedCollege.description: An approved college or university whose email domain is allowed to join StudyCircle.

name.description: Full display name of the college (2 to 120 characters).

emailDomain.description: Lowercase email domain without @, e.g., aiims.edu or iitd.ac.in.

active.description: Whether students from this domain can currently register.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: A StudyCircle user account profile with college, department, trial, and AI quota metadata.

email.description: Verified email address of the student.

collegeId.description: ID of the allowedCollege document (immutable after creation for non-admins).

department.description: Academic department such as MBBS, B.Tech, BDS, Nursing (immutable after creation for non-admins).

country.description: Country name or ISO code (2 to 60 characters).

role.description: RBAC role. Must be 'student' on self-registration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

trialStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when the 3-day free trial started.

subscriptionStatus.description: Current subscription status. Must be 'trial' on creation.

subscriptionEndsAt.description: Server timestamp when the active subscription or trial ends.

premiumBonusDays.description: Bonus premium days earned from referrals (granted by admin).

referralCode.description: Unique referral code for this student (4 to 24 characters).

referredBy.description: Optional referral code of the classmate who invited this user.

blocked.description: Whether the user has been blocked by an admin/moderator. Must be false on creation.

aiUsageDate.description: UTC date string YYYY-MM-DD for tracking daily AI study helper usage.

aiUsedToday.description: Number of AI study questions used on aiUsageDate (0 to 15).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: A semester-wise, subject-wise, general, or student-created discussion room scoped to a collegeId and department.

collegeId.description: College ID that owns this room.

semester.description: Target semester (0 for all-semester general/discussion rooms, 1-12 for semester-specific).

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message or room creation.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A message inside a room (text, meetLink, or notes/PDF link).

collegeId.description: Denormalized collegeId matching the parent room for fast zero-trust list verification.

department.description: Denormalized department matching the parent room.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender (2 to 59 characters).

text.description: Trimmed message text, Meet URL description, or resource link (1 to 2000 characters).

linkUrl.description: Optional external URL for meetLink or shared study notes/PDF link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag when sender or moderator/admin deletes a message.

DoubtPost.title: DoubtPost
DoubtPost.description: An academic doubt question posted by a student within their college and department.

authorId.description: UID of the student asking the doubt.

authorName.description: Name of the student asking the doubt (2 to 59 characters).

solved.description: Whether the author marked an answer as the best answer.

DoubtAnswer.title: DoubtAnswer
DoubtAnswer.description: An answer to a doubt post inside doubts/{doubtId}/answers/{answerId}.

collegeId.description: Denormalized collegeId of the parent doubt.

department.description: Denormalized department of the parent doubt.

authorName.description: Name of the answering student (2 to 59 characters).

upvotedBy.description: Bounded list of up to 200 user IDs who upvoted this answer.

best.description: Whether this answer is marked as the best answer.

AbuseReport.title: AbuseReport
AbuseReport.description: A student-submitted abuse report against a message or user.

reporterId.description: UID of the student filing the report.

messageId.description: ID of the reported message (or 'profile' if user report).

roomId.description: ID of the room where the incident happened.

UserBlockList.title: UserBlockList
UserBlockList.description: Per-user list of blocked user IDs stored at blocks/{uid}.

blockedIds.description: Bounded list (max 200) of UIDs blocked by this student.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when block list was updated.

StudyPlanner.title: StudyPlanner
StudyPlanner.description: Per-student exam countdown and study-session schedule stored at planner/{uid}.

examName.description: Title of upcoming exam (1 to 100 characters).

examDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of upcoming exam.

sessions.description: Bounded array (max 50) of study session strings (e.g., '2026-11-20 | 18:00 | Anatomy Ch 4 | 60m').

SponsoredAd.title: SponsoredAd
SponsoredAd.description: Sponsored advertisement created by an advertiser and approved by an admin.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS image or banner URL (0 to 500 characters).

placement.description: Where the ad appears (never inside private chats or blocking popups).

advertiserId.description: UID of the advertiser who created the ad.

targetSemester.description: Target semester (0 for all semesters, 1-12 for specific).

status.description: Approval lifecycle state. Only approved ads are visible to students.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Records when a new student joins using a classmate's referral code so an admin can grant bonus premium days.

referrerUid.description: UID of the student who owns the referralCode.

newStudentUid.description: UID of the newly registered student.

newStudentName.description: Name of the newly registered student.

bonusDaysGranted.description: Number of bonus premium days granted by admin (0 when pending).

status.description: Whether an admin has granted the referral reward.

/users/{userId}.description: Student, moderator, advertiser, and admin user profiles.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Semester, subject, general, and discussion rooms.

/doubts/{doubtId}.description: Student doubt posts scoped by college and department.

/doubts/{doubtId}/answers/{answerId}.description: Answers and upvotes for a doubt post.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Abuse reports filed by students and reviewed by admins.

/planner/{userId}.description: Per-student exam countdown and study session planner.

/referrals/{referralId}.description: Referral redemptions awaiting or granted admin bonus days.
